subject: Request: Marketplace private listing concession and billing cadence for NovaMart Q4 pilot
messages:
From: Linda Hoffman <linda.hoffman@novamart.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@novamart.com
Date: 2028-06-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Private listing for NovaMart pilot — billing cadence & rev-share ask

Hi Karthik / Marissa,

Thanks again for the product walkthrough yesterday. NovaMart is excited to run a Q4 pilot (12-week) of Redwood inference for our personalized search tier. Procurement asked me to follow up with two asks that are blocking internal approval:

1) Billing cadence — NovaMart prefers a monthly invoice (pass-through) for marketplace charges for the pilot rather than the standard marketplace billing schedule. Can Redwood accommodate monthly invoicing for the pilot?

2) Rev-share floor — the standard AWS marketplace rev-share floor is higher than what our CFO is comfortable with for a pilot. We are requesting a temporary rev-share reduction (proposed: 12% for pilot) with a commitment to review at pilot completion.

I've attached the SOW and our proposed pricing model to this thread. We understand concessions are exceptional, and are happy to sign a short addendum that captures the limited time frame and rollback terms.

Appreciate quick guidance so we can lock timelines.

Best,
Linda Hoffman
Head of Cloud Partnerships, NovaMart
Attachments: NovaMart_SOW.pdf (application/pdf), nova_pricing-model.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Linda Hoffman <linda.hoffman@novamart.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, connor_obrien@redwood.com
Date: 2028-06-09T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private listing for NovaMart pilot — billing cadence & rev-share ask

Linda — thanks for the clear asks and the SOW. This is an important pilot and I want to move it forward. A couple of notes from our side:

- Monthly invoice pass-through for the pilot is not standard for marketplace listings (most clouds require their billing flow). That said, for pilots we sometimes do a limited pass-through/invoice cadence if finance signs off and Legal approves a short addendum.

- Rev-share: 12% is below our normal floor for private offers in the marketplace. We can escalate for a program-level concession if there is a clear commit (e.g., minimum platform spend over the pilot or follow-on purchase commitment).

I'm escalating to Rev/Deal Desk for an exec-level decision and copying Marissa and Connor to loop in Finance/Legal. Internal ask: can we get an exception for monthly invoice cadence for a 12-week pilot and a one-time rev-share floor concession to 12% with these conditions: (1) NovaMart signs addendum that states pilot-only concession and rollback terms; (2) minimum platform spend $60k during pilot; (3) SOC 2 attestation provided prior to go-live.

Linda — I will follow up with a decision and any required paperwork by EOD.

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Cloud Partnerships — Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: connor_obrien@redwood.com
Date: 2028-06-09T12:11:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Private listing for NovaMart pilot — billing cadence & rev-share ask

Hi Lauren / Monica — forwarding NovaMart's request. See original request below from Linda.

TL;DR: Requesting (A) monthly invoicing/pass-through for a 12-week pilot, and (B) temporary rev-share floor of 12% (our floor is normally 18-20% depending on marketplace and tier). They propose $60k minimum spend for the pilot. They are willing to sign a pilot addendum.

Why I'm escalating: this is a strategic retail account and a pilot could convert to a larger listing commit. However we need an exception to both marketplace billing cadence (Finance) and rev-share floor (Rev/Exec).

Would you consider a conditional approval if Finance signs off on monthly invoice cadence for pilot and Legal approves a short addendum limiting the concession to pilot timeframe? If yes, please indicate any guardrails (caps, repayment if they exceed usage, timeline).

Cc: finance-ops@redwood.com, legal-deals@redwood.com
Date: 2028-06-09T14:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Private listing for NovaMart pilot — billing cadence & rev-share ask

Marissa / team — I reviewed the ask and the deal context. I will approve a constrained concession with the following conditions:

1) Rev-share reduction to 12% approved for the 12-week pilot only. Concession will be captured in a 3-page addendum signed by both parties that explicitly states the date range and automatic reversion to standard rev-share at pilot end.

2) Monthly invoice cadence for the pilot is approved as a temporary pass-through. Finance Ops to generate monthly invoices for the pilot period; marketplace listing will remain a private offer but Redwood will invoice NovaMart monthly and pursue collection (Finance to add a non-standard billing flow).

3) Minimum platform spend requirement of $60,000 during pilot must be contractually committed. If spend falls short of $60k, the difference will be invoiced at standard rev-share rates retroactively.

4) Legal to attach SOC 2 attestation and sign-off required before go-live. No data residency exceptions.

5) This approval is limited to NovaMart pilot only and does not set precedent. Any future ask must go through Deal Desk with explicit executive sign-off.

Next steps: Marissa / Karthik — please work with Legal (copied) to draft the addendum and route to NovaMart for signature. Monica / Finance Ops — please confirm you can generate monthly invoice cadence for the 12-week window and confirm collections handling. Once signed, Ops will coordinate with Marketplace Listing to enable the private offer.

Lauren Bishop
VP, Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference
